mapIdentity.scope: The named park way and native Oda Castle story identity locate the original castle. The elevation survey anchors the surviving main enclosure rim and moat. The verified park photographs show the representative wooden crossings and monument.

note: The city documents the current layout and the northern, eastern and southwestern approaches. The elevation model supplies relief. Widths of the modern boardwalk and some edges are inferred from the author’s ground photographs.
